ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: A Playwright's Work - Lynn Nottage. It has been said that all her plays are "amazingly different," and she has categorized her writing as "nomadic" as she is "always looking for a space or an idea that hasn't been explored on the stage." Lynn Nottage, a two-time Pulitzer Prize winner and MacArthur Grant recipient states that she "writes to understand" as she engages in varied research practices through which she builds stories. We will explore her full creative life from her well-known and lesser-known plays to her ventures into tv, film and opera.
